_comment: OpenClaw cron descriptor for the daily Almanac generator. Register this job by adding it to the workspace automations registry (memory/automations/latest-manifest.json) or by running the automation indexer after placing a copy of this file in memory/automations/almanac-generator.json.
name: Daily Almanac Generator
description: Generates the next day's Almanac edition with Tavily-backed web discovery, validates against the DailyData schema, and writes the immutable snapshot to alphalpha:almanac:edition:{date} in KV.
summary: Full pipeline (Phases 1–11): quotes, You chart, article, look/image, ventures, surprise/artifact rotation, investing/AI signal charts, riff videos, production clips, poem, long read, and Austin Explore. Scheduled runs are injected as main-session system events because isolated agent-turn cron runs currently lack shell execution; failures must report RUN_FAILED visibly instead of being treated as a silent success.
